_readme: The single list of what is imported into the site. Only files listed here are copied.
src: exact path relative to the media folder (the parent of this repo). Names are matched exactly, including spaces and case.
id: logical name used by data/*.json and as the output path under assets/img/. Lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '/' only.
kind: photo | render | screenshot | plot | graphic. It selects the WebP settings in build_media.py.
credit (optional): photographer credit shown on the photo. George Lawrence's competition photos must carry "@glawrence_photography" (check_site enforces it).
poster_frame (optional, animations only): which frame of an animated GIF becomes the still poster. Default 0.
videos: short clips (id, src, alt). Each becomes a silent H.264 MP4 under assets/video/clips/ with a poster image.
